caveats: The Q4 value is derived, not reported directly. It equals full-year 2025 capex (28,358,000,000) minus the nine-month year-to-date figure (20,908,000,000).
Capex is measured as payments to acquire property, plant and equipment.

claims.text: ExxonMobil's capital expenditures (payments to acquire property, plant and equipment) in fiscal Q4 2025 were about $7.45 billion. This is derived as FY2025 capex of $28.358 billion minus the nine-month figure of $20.908 billion.

raw_output.summary: ExxonMobil's capital expenditures in fiscal Q4 2025 (Oct 1 – Dec 31, 2025) were about $7.45 billion. This is a derived figure: full-year 2025 capex minus the nine-month figure.
